note.title: Fleet rollout verification
note.body:
Fleet source updates/2026-11-10/fleet-default-limit.md (blob 0951003a7d83af8591a151bf560da0f4bebe1150).
Observed by the independent release verifier: before the change, explicit zero and omitted limits returned zero frames. In the accepted tree both returned three, in source order.
Reviewed candidate 45211c60a81da3b87d8e25e46afa8ffd89f47840. Accepted project version 45211c60a81da3b87d8e25e46afa8ffd89f47840.
Project contribution ctb-498c69f1f25ef8e1c08cb80a6069e614 / ctd-fbda4e9e76f3d6dfbd0f4e9271e5c5fa / ACCEPT_AS_CANDIDATE: Use the measured zero-frame counterexample to revise the stream default and its public tests. Preserve the existing wire contract.

recorded.finding: Both the explicit-zero and omitted requests returned zero Readings for site-a on the basis although Fleet requires three.
recorded.note: Use the measured zero-frame counterexample to revise the stream default and its public tests. Preserve the existing wire contract.
